description: This file contains the implementation of the ArcBufferWriter class, which is a specialized buffer writer for creating ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances using pooled arrays. It manages pages of data, handles memory allocation, and provides methods for writing, peeking, slicing, and managing buffer pages within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers namespace.

classes.name: ArcBufferWriter
classes.description: A buffer writer implementation that uses pooled arrays to create ReadOnlySequence<byte> instances, managing pages of data and providing methods for writing, peeking, and slicing buffers.

classes.name: ArcBufferPage
classes.description: Represents a page of data in the buffer, managing memory, reference counting, versioning, and linked list navigation.

classes.name: ArcBufferPagePool
classes.description: A pool managing reusable ArcBufferPage instances, providing methods to rent and return pages, optimizing memory usage.

classes.name: ArcBuffer
classes.description: A slice of data within the buffer, supporting copying, slicing, pinning, and enumeration over its segments.

classes.name: ArcBufferReader
classes.description: Provides read-only access to an ArcBuffer, allowing peeking, consuming, and slicing of data.

classes.name: PageSegment
classes.description: Defines a segment of a page within an ArcBuffer, representing a specific region of data.

classes.name: PageSegmentEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerates over page segments within an ArcBuffer.

classes.name: PageEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerates over pages within an ArcBuffer.

classes.name: SpanEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerates over spans of bytes in an ArcBuffer.

classes.name: MemoryEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerates over ReadOnlyMemory<byte> segments in an ArcBuffer.

classes.name: ArraySegmentEnumerator
classes.description: Enumerates over ArraySegment<byte> segments in an ArcBuffer.

classes.name: ReadOnlySequenceSegment
classes.description: A helper class for creating segments of a ReadOnlySequence<byte> for enumeration purposes.

methods.name: ArcBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer writer and renting the first page.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Property returning the number of unconsumed bytes in the buffer.

methods.name: ReplenishBuffers
methods.description: Adds additional buffers to a list until capacity is reached, allocating new pages as needed.

methods.name: AdvanceWriter
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer writer, returning all memory and reinitializing pages.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the buffer writer, unpinning pages and marking it as disposed.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> for writing, possibly allocating a new page.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> for writing, possibly allocating a new page.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> of the current data without consuming it.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Copies data into a span without advancing the read position.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySequence<byte> into the buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> into the buffer, handling multi-segment writes.

methods.name: WriteMultiSegment
methods.description: Helper method to write a span across multiple pages.

methods.name: UnpinAll
methods.description: Unpins all pages currently in use.

methods.name: PeekSlice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the buffer as an ArcBuffer without consuming data.

methods.name: ConsumeSlice
methods.description: Returns a slice of the buffer and advances the read position.

methods.name: AdvanceReader
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: AllocatePage
methods.description: Allocates a new page, linking it into the page list.

methods.name: AdvanceWritePage
methods.description: Advances to the next page for writing, allocating if necessary.

methods.name: ThrowIfDisposed
methods.description: Throws an exception if the writer has been disposed.
